latest.title: ‘Highly advanced’ quantum computers could crack financial encryption in five years
latest.description: No quantum computer can yet break widely used cryptography, but the securities watchdog says banks and blockchains face a yearslong security overhaul that many have barely begun.

latest.title: APEC final day in photos: Trump, Xi and Putin shake hands; Takaichi kept at a distance
latest.description: Leaders gathered Thursday for the second day of the economic summit, ahead of a historic trilateral meeting between the U.S., Russia and China.

latest.title: Live updates: Bitcoin nears $64,000 as Anthropic’s record IPO lifts tech
latest.description: Nasdaq futures jumped nearly 2% with Anthropic shares indicated as much as 24% higher, and one analyst said IPO money could flow back into crypto.

latest.title: Denmark ratifies Trump security deal over Greenland after months of diplomatic tensions
latest.description: It follows months of tensions after President Donald Trump repeatedly said the U.S. should take control of Greenland for national security reasons.

latest.title: Singapore settles $77.5 million tokenized bill sale in local CBDC
latest.description: The central bank aims to expand this digital settlement network and test wider collateral use in 2027.

latest.title: Trump says U.S., China, Russia ‘uniquely positioned’ to discuss reducing nuclear weapons at historic meeting
latest.description: The leaders of the U.S., China and Russia met in Shenzhen on Thursday for a rare trilateral gathering.

latest.title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
latest.description: A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable.

latest.title: Bitcoin Struggles to Hold $64,000 as ETF Outflows Hit $2.9B in November
latest.description: Bitcoin is down 13% in a week as investors pull money from spot ETFs and brace for another Federal Reserve rate hike.

latest.title: Roundhill scraps Solana and XRP income ETFs as rival funds indicate low demand
latest.description: Roundhill withdrew plans for two funds designed to generate income from SOL and XRP, highlighting the gap between billions invested in spot crypto ETFs and limited demand for more specialized strategies.

latest.title: Data center electricity use could double by 2030, IEA says
latest.description: Global electricity use by data centers could double by 2030 as the AI boom adds pressure to power grids across the world, according to the IEA.

latest.title: Novartis raises blockbuster drug forecasts to $18 billion as it seeks to prove growth can last
latest.description: The drugmaker cited strong demand for its blockbuster drugs as it upgraded peak sales forecasts for multiple sclerosis, leukemia, and cholesterol medicines.

latest.title: Trump praises ‘great relationship’ with Putin after meeting, as Ukraine war takes center stage
latest.description: U.S. President Donald Trump met individually on Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin, as well as Chinese President Xi Jinping.

latest.title: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
latest.description: MAS issued the bills directly on its test network, which it plans to rename SG Digital Ledger and use for settlement beyond the trials.

latest.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
latest.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.

latest.title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
latest.description: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.

latest.title: Bitcoin retests $62K as Nasdaq futures rise ahead of Anthropic debut
latest.description: Bitcoin climbed back above $63,500 after its second dip to $62,000 this week, while Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO at $83 a share.

latest.title: Takaichi gets chilly reception in China on first Japan leader visit since 2019
latest.description: Takaichi received a subdued welcome on her trip to attend the APEC summit, as Beijing shows limited appetite for repairing ties strained by Taiwan dispute.

latest.title: Fed's rate hike push may be a mistake. Here's why
latest.description: Experts argue that the Fed is looking at the wrong data as it pushes for more interest-rate hikes, with falling gasoline and energy prices suggesting inflation pressures are already easing.

latest.title: Musk accuses Zelenskyy of lying about Starshield restrictions in Ukraine
latest.description: Elon Musk was asked about Zelenskyy claims over the Starshield network, and he said, "I don't want to blow your mind, but Zelenskyy is not always truthful."
